candidates.rule: The harness must run two runtimes: an inner kit/L1 runtime and an outer collection, analysis, strategy, and audit runtime. They may communicate only through memory and bus files, with schema checks and heartbeats, and the inner runtime gets model-budget priority.
candidates.quote: two runtimes (inner: kit and L1, outer: collection, analysis, strategy, audit) talking only through memory/bus/ files with schema checks, heartbeats and inner-first model budget
candidates.harness: Enforce the runtime boundary, file-only communication, schemas, heartbeats, and inner-first model budgeting.

candidates.rule: Each L1 role may have at most eight tools; prompts must put static material first, isolate counterpart messages regex-first, and use a model-call breaker.
candidates.quote: at most 8 tools per L1 role (T1), static-first prompt order (C1), regex-first isolation of counterpart messages (S1)
candidates.harness: Apply the tool limit and prompt ordering/isolation rules, and stop calls through a breaker when needed.

candidates.rule: Bus events must have event IDs and readers must use cursors.
candidates.quote: event ids and cursors on the bus (S2)
candidates.harness: Attach event IDs and track reader cursors on bus events.

candidates.rule: Log each tool call before it runs and log its result afterward.
candidates.quote: tool.call logged before running, tool.result after
candidates.harness: Write the call record before execution and the result record after execution.

candidates.rule: During night mode from 01:00 through 08:00, operate in reports-only mode.
candidates.harness: Do not take market actions during the 01:00–08:00 reports-only period.

candidates.rule: When copying a run, copy keys and memory but not logs; the log must start with `market_kit 4`.
candidates.quote: copy keys and memory but not logs (log must start with market_kit 4)
candidates.harness: Copy keys and memory only, and verify the required log header.

candidates.rule: Round 3 messages can contain SKUs and hour counts after prices, so the final number must not automatically be interpreted as the price.
candidates.quote: 'last number is the price' misread SKUs and hour counts in Round 3 messages
candidates.harness: Parse message fields and distinguish prices from SKUs and hour counts.

candidates.rule: A goods purchase must be refused when it would lower an over-limit food share.
candidates.quote: check.buy refused goods purchases that lower an over-limit food share
candidates.harness: Reject goods purchases that meet this stated food-share condition.

candidates.rule: The stock cap is calculated as a share of the 2,000,000 starting capital, not the shrinking balance.
candidates.quote: the stock cap is a share of the starting capital (D31: 2,000,000), not of the shrinking balance
candidates.harness: Calculate the stock cap using 2,000,000 as the capital base.

candidates.rule: Shops that cheated the agent are blocked immediately.
candidates.quote: shops that cheated us blocked at once
candidates.harness: Block a shop as soon as cheating is established.

candidates.rule: Seller priority 1 is to watch what sells now, rather than relying on the A2A card.
candidates.quote: priority 1 watches what sells now (market.selling planned for step 5), not the A2A card
candidates.harness: Base the top seller priority on current selling information, not the A2A card.

candidates.rule: Executors must read only their own role’s card section.
candidates.quote: executors read only their own role
candidates.harness: Restrict each executor to its own role’s card section.

candidates.rule: The card must carry the strategy in force, including phase, analyst and strategy context, hypothesis, limits, and priorities.
candidates.quote: the card carries the strategy in force (phase, context from analysts and strategy, hypothesis, limits, priorities)
candidates.harness: Supply those current strategy fields in the card passed to the executor.

candidates.rule: The seller card was about 1,300 tokens before priorities and exceeded the 2,000-token L1 budget once tools and situation context were added.
candidates.quote: The seller's card is ~1,300 tokens before priorities, over the 2,000-token L1 budget once tools and the situation are added
candidates.harness: Keep the assembled L1 prompt within its 2,000-token budget.

candidates.rule: The reviewed L1 prompt was about 4,000 tokens, exceeding the stated 2,000-token budget.
candidates.harness: Measure assembled prompts and reduce them to fit the 2,000-token budget.

candidates.rule: The user approved and installed strategy v1; its thresholds are starting points, not fixed final values.
candidates.quote: strategy v1 approved by the user and installed
candidates.harness: Use the installed strategy and treat its thresholds as initial values that can be revised.

candidates.rule: The user chose strategy v2 with rollback when total losses exceed 500,000.
candidates.quote: strategy v2 = v1 with rollback at losses.total > 500,000 (user)
candidates.harness: Roll back the strategy when total losses exceed 500,000.

candidates.rule: Unit-economics exposure cost measures below-cost differences separately from losses.
candidates.quote: eval.unit_economics reports exposure_cost (below-cost differences) apart from losses
candidates.harness: Report exposure cost as a separate measure from losses.
